name: ZeResFDG (CADE 2.5)
plain: Combines frequency scaling, CFG-Zero style uncond scale, and rescale, with an automatic switch based on high-frequency share.
math:
FD(v)=λ_l G*v+λ_h(v−G*v)
cfgzero_fd: a=⟨c,u⟩/⟨u,u⟩; x̂=au+wFD(c−au)
rescale_fdg: d=u+wFD(Δ); x̂=m·d·std(c)/std(d)+(1−m)d
auto: hysteresis on EMA of ‖Δ_h‖²/‖Δ‖²
